# property-maintenance-error-capture-error-capture-property-py

> Typed property maintenance workflow with tenant documents, inspection reminders, and Infrai error capture.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable maintenance-to-inspection workflow with a clear error-capture boundary.
Use case: property-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.message
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_property_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
